title: ARS user-attested reading ledger (peer file of the Material Passport)
description: Schema for <passport-stem>_human_read_log.yaml, the user-owned USER_ATTESTED_READ ledger written by scripts/ars_mark_read.py (v3.6.8 §3.6; #513/#738 read_scope attestation). It records a declaration, not verified reading or comprehension. Deliberately a sidecar: literature_corpus_entry.schema.json stays adapter-owned and unmodified. The ledger is append-only; unmark appends rescinded_at, never deletes. New marks require read_scope; legacy absence means coverage_unknown and never licenses promotion to ok. Nothing is inferred or backfilled.

citation_key.description: Joins against literature_corpus[].citation_key in the active passport.

attestation_type.description: Written on new marks. Optional only so pre-#738 ledger entries remain parseable as legacy declarations.

rescinded_at.description: Appended in place by /ars-unmark-read; presence means this mark no longer counts. Most-recent-timestamp-wins per v3.6.8 §3.6.

read_scope.description: #513/#738 coverage attestation: how much of the source the user declares reading. Declaration-only — adapters and agents never infer or backfill it. `unknown` is explicit coverage_unknown and never licenses promotion to ok. Locators require level: sections.

locators.description: Free-text section/page declarations (e.g. 'pp. 10-24', 'section 3'). Only meaningful — and only accepted by the CLI — with level: sections.

rfc3339_utc.description: RFC 3339 timestamp normalized to UTC with a literal Z suffix. The runtime also validates calendar/time values and rescinded_at >= marked_at.
